build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with parameterized segment lengths and angles
create_static_bar: create a static bar body with configurable scale angle and position using C.add
add_dynamic_jar: add a dynamic jar body to the scene and position it using push and set_angle
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball body centered on another body using C.add with center_x and center_y
update_task_relationship: update the task goal by setting a TOUCHING spatial relationship between two bodies
